name: wechat-article-layout
description: WeChat article layout assistant: turns a finished draft, or screenshots plus a few notes, into a formatted article that pastes into the WeChat editor without losing styles, with six themes.

displayDescription.en: Send a draft, or screenshots plus a few notes, and get a WeChat article written in your voice and laid out in one of six themes, ready to paste without losing formatting.
displayDescription.zh: 发稿子或截图加几句要讲的，帮你写成公众号图文并排好版，六套主题任选，粘进后台不掉格式

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我写一篇公众号操作图文，讲“第一次用AI表格整理客户名单”：先把Excel导进去，再让AI按地区分组，最后一键查重。截图我还没截，需要截图的地方先留空位，写好直接排版给我看。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Write a WeChat how-to article on "sorting a customer list with an AI spreadsheet for the first time": import the Excel file, have AI group customers by region, then remove duplicates in one click. I have no screenshots yet, so leave placeholders where they go, and give me the laid-out preview.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我写一篇公众号操作图文，讲“第一次用AI表格整理客户名单”：先把Excel导进去，再让AI按地区分组，最后一键查重。截图我还没截，需要截图的地方先留空位，写好直接排版给我看。
quickPrompts.en: Write a WeChat how-to article on "sorting a customer list with an AI spreadsheet for the first time": import the Excel file, have AI group customers by region, then remove duplicates in one click. I have no screenshots yet, so leave placeholders where they go, and give me the laid-out preview.

quickPrompts.zh: 这段是我写好的公众号文章，照原文帮我排成公众号图文，不要改内容：上周有个老板问我，用了AI以后员工反而更忙了，是不是哪里不对？其实问题不在AI，在流程。我们后来做了三件事：第一，先把要AI干的活写成规矩；第二，每次人工改稿都记下原因；第三，每周复盘一次。一个月后，返工明显少了。
quickPrompts.en: Here is an article I already wrote. Lay it out for WeChat exactly as written, without changing the content: Last week a business owner asked me why his staff got busier after adopting AI. The problem was not AI but the process. We did three things: wrote the rules for what AI should do, recorded the reason for every manual edit, and reviewed weekly. A month later, rework had clearly dropped.

quickPrompts.zh: 我要发一篇踩坑实录，讲“AI写的客服话术被客户投诉了”。先给我看六套排版主题的缩略图，推荐一套，再用推荐的主题把这篇写出来排好。
quickPrompts.en: I want to publish a lessons-learned post about "customer-service replies written by AI that got a complaint". Show me thumbnails of the six layout themes, recommend one, then write the article and lay it out in that theme.
